text:
maya: Heads up — the Python quickstart page is 404 and the code sample is using the old sync API (causing runtime + mypy errors). Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/python

sam: Ack, can you paste the snippet + the traceback you saw?

maya: Sure — minimal snippet from the page:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.generate("Write a haiku about GPUs")
print(resp.text)
```
Error: AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'generate'
Plus mypy: error: "RedwoodClient" is not awaitable (we're getting coroutine vs Response typing mismatches). Repro: pip install redwood==0.9.0; run the above.

ryan: Thanks — we recently switched docs to an async-first sample but apparently the old sync snippet remained on the quickstart. That explains both the 404 and the API mismatch. We should update the page to the new async sample and add a redirect for the old URL.

sam: New async-first example that matches the SDK surface (and avoids the mypy pain):```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncRedwoodClient

async def main():
    async with AsyncRedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY") as client:
        resp = await client.chat.create(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}])
        print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
This uses context manager + awaitable methods.

sam: On the typing side — AsyncRedwoodClient currently has __aenter__/__aexit__ typed loosely which trips mypy in strict-checkers. Short-term we can add narrower stubs in typeshed or update our package to include better annotations for __aenter__ returning "AsyncRedwoodClient". I'll open a small typing patch.

alex: From a PM/ops perspective: please do two things: (1) add a redirect for the old quickstart URL so external links don't 404; (2) add a docs CI smoke test that fetches the quickstart and runs the example in a minimal venv (catch these breaks earlier). Create an issue and link PRs to it.

sam: I'll draft PR 482 that: updates the quickstart to the async snippet, improves typing hints in the package (small __aenter__ return type change), and adds a test in docs CI. Assigning to @ryan for docs review.

ryan: I'll review ASAP. Also will add a tiny HTML redirect for the legacy path so search/links don't break.
